maintenance: Yearly, after GERC issues the new orders (usually March to June): read every order in full, not only the changes, add one new entry to orders below, and update docs/ENERGY-LEDGER.md. Never edit an old entry: companies keep the rates of the month each bill belongs to.

orders.title: GERC Tariff Order dated 25 March 2026, FY 2026-27 (Annexure: Tariff Schedule)
orders.ref: MGVCL Case No. 2582 of 2025; the same schedule applies to DGVCL, MGVCL, PGVCL and UGVCL (DGVCL circular 0234/04/2026, PGVCL circular 0291/04/2026)
general: Green Power
Rs 0.75 per kWh above the normal tariff for consumers who opt for it, on one month's notice (General condition 18).
ToU charges
Levied only if a meter with ToD recording is provided (General condition 15).
Excess demand
Paying the excess rate gives no right to draw above the contract demand (General condition 13).
PF penalty
Paying the penalty does not excuse the consumer from improving the power factor (General condition 14).
Delayed payment
None within ten days of the bill date; after the due date 15% a year till paid (General condition 16).
Fixed charge rounding
Billed in steps of 0.5 kVA or kW, a smaller fraction going up to the next 0.5. Energy is billed in whole kWh (General condition 8).
FPPAS
Worked out and billed every month by formula (General condition 12). Base power purchase cost Rs 5.11/kWh, base FPPPA Rs 2.45/kWh, average billing rate Rs 6.77/kWh (circular).
Duty
Tariffs exclude Electricity Duty and taxes, which are charged on top (General condition 2).
Open access
Cross subsidy surcharge Rs 1.33 per unit. Wheeling 23.52 paise per kWh at 11, 22 and 33 kV, 111.05 paise at 400 V (circular).

HTP-1.name: HTP-I, regular HT supply, 100 kVA and above
extra: Seasonal consumers
Minimum Rs 4,550 per kVA a year, off-season units at 430 paise (para 11.11).

HTP-II.name: HTP-II, water works and sewerage pumping by local authorities, GWSSB and GIDC

HTP-IV.name: HTP-IV, night use only, 22:00 to 06:00, by option
extra: Night use
Demand is one third of HTP-I. Up to 15% of contract demand and 10% of units may be used outside the night hours. Beyond either limit that month is billed at HTP-I rates (para 14, notes 1 to 5).

LTMD.name: LTMD, low tension above 40 kW

touDiscount.hours: 11:00 to 17:00, with a ToD or smart meter

extra: Reactive energy
10 paise per kVARh for all reactive units (para 5.4).
Prepaid
Smart prepaid energy charge 446 paise per unit while the balance stays positive.
